description: This file handles the webhook for successful phone number subscriptions, validating checkout session data, and redirecting users accordingly.

methods.name: handler
methods.description: Main async function handling the webhook request, parsing session ID, retrieving session, validating metadata, and redirecting.

methods.name: getCheckoutSession
methods.description: Retrieves the Stripe checkout session by ID, expanding the subscription details.

methods.name: validateAndExtractMetadata
methods.description: Validates the session's payment status and metadata, returning structured metadata.

methods.name: redirectToSuccess
methods.description: Redirects the user to the appropriate success URL based on metadata.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles errors by logging and redirecting to an error URL with message.
